Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building age, size, classrooms, specialized spaces, and detailed site plans (Sections 5.1-5.7). Robust condition assessment covers HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility with connection to student outcomes and long-term capital planning (Sections 5.2-5.7, 6.3).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology and long-term horizon; capacity utilization data by site and classroom; explicit strategies for new construction, modernization, and consolidation linked to enrollment trends (Sections 2.3, 4.3, 6.4).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications for TK, CTE, special education, project-based learning, and flexible classrooms; clear integration of educational goals with facility projects (Sections 2.3, 3.2, 5.2-5.7).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces such as playfields, quads, and shade structures; identifies strategies for improvement including new amphitheaters and learning courts; some districtwide coverage but less emphasis on climate resilience framing (Sections 5.2-5.7, 6.3).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related concerns such as irrigation efficiency and shade but lacks comprehensive districtwide climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies; sustainability goals discussed in committee meetings (Sections 2.2, 6.2).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as HVAC upgrades, lighting controls, and some renewable readiness; references Title 24 and state goals; energy resilience mentioned but lacks comprehensive districtwide resilience plan (Sections 2.2, 5.2-5.7, 6.3).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with escalation assumptions; clear prioritization framework aligned with educational and safety goals; multiple funding strategies including bonds and state programs; long-term financial sustainability considered (Sections 4.1-4.4, 6.3-6.4).
